news.titleEn: Longer-Dated Treasury Yields Rise as Bessent's Bond Buyback Rally Fizzles Out
news.conclusionEn: The 30-year US Treasury yield hit 5.34% this week, its highest since 2007, and Treasury Secretary Bessent's surprise plan to double bond buybacks only calmed markets for about a day before yields climbed back.
news.conclusionZh: 美国30年期国债收益率本周触及5.34%，为2007年来最高，财长贝森特加倍回购的干预仅平息市场约一天。
news.whyEn: Rising long-term yields raise borrowing costs across mortgages, corporate debt and the government's own $40 trillion-plus debt load, and the fact that Bessent's intervention barely worked signals investors remain deeply worried about US inflation and fiscal sustainability.
news.whyZh: 长期收益率上升会推高房贷、企业融资及政府自身超40万亿美元债务的成本，干预效果不佳也显示市场对美国通胀与财政可持续性的担忧根深蒂固。
news.detailEn: The 30-year Treasury yield surged to 5.34% on Tuesday, its highest level since 2007, before the global financial crisis, driven by investor concern over persistent inflation, ballooning government debt, and competition from corporate AI-buildout debt sapping demand for Treasuries. In response, the Treasury Department announced Wednesday it would at least double the size of its long-dated debt buyback operations, from $2 billion to at least $4 billion per operation, with the program running from September 9 through November 4. Yields dropped sharply on the announcement, but the relief lasted roughly one day: by Thursday the 30-year yield had climbed back above 5.27%, erasing most of the improvement. The episode underscores how limited the Treasury's tools are to contain the yield spike even as total public debt has already surpassed $40 trillion.
news.detailZh: 30年期美债收益率周二飙升至5.34%，为2007年全球金融危机前以来最高水平，原因是投资者担忧持续通胀、政府债务膨胀，以及企业为AI建设发债分流了国债需求。财政部随后于周三宣布，将把长期债务回购操作规模至少翻倍，从每次20亿美元提高到至少40亿美元，该计划将于9月9日至11月4日执行。消息公布后收益率一度大幅回落，但缓解仅维持约一天：到周四，30年期收益率已回升至5.27%以上，此前的改善基本被抹去。这一波动凸显出，即便公共债务总额已突破40万亿美元，财政部用以遏制收益率飙升的工具仍相当有限。

news.titleEn: Marvell Gives Google Option to Buy $12.2 Billion Stake in Custom AI Chip Deal
news.conclusionEn: Marvell granted Google a warrant to purchase up to $12.2 billion worth of its shares as part of an expanded deal to help build Google's custom AI chips, sending Marvell's stock up sharply while rival Broadcom fell.
news.conclusionZh: Marvell向谷歌授予认股权证，允许其购买最多122亿美元股份，以换取深化AI定制芯片合作，Marvell股价大涨，博通则下跌。
news.whyEn: The deal is a major vote of confidence from a top cloud provider in Marvell's custom-chip capabilities, intensifying competition in the AI semiconductor supply chain and signaling that hyperscalers are increasingly locking in long-term chip suppliers with equity stakes rather than just purchase contracts.
news.whyZh: 此举是云计算巨头对Marvell定制芯片能力的重大信任投票，加剧了AI芯片供应链的竞争，也显示科技巨头正以股权而非单纯采购合同来锁定长期芯片供应商。
news.detailEn: Under the agreement, Google receives a warrant to buy up to 58.97 million Marvell shares at $206.58 apiece, worth $12.18 billion if fully exercised, which would make Google one of Marvell's largest shareholders. Roughly 240,000 shares vest for every $500 million in qualifying chip purchases Google makes from Marvell, and the partnership could generate an estimated $120 billion in revenue for Marvell through fiscal 2033. The deal covers a broad range of technologies used alongside Google's TPUs, including processors that run AI models, manage data storage, and move information across data-center networks. Marvell shares jumped nearly 8-10% on the news, while shares of larger rival Broadcom, which also supplies custom AI chips to Google, fell more than 5% as investors weighed the shift in Google's supplier mix.
news.detailZh: 根据协议，谷歌获得以每股206.58美元价格购买最多5897万股Marvell股票的认股权证，若全部行使价值达121.8亿美元，将使谷歌成为Marvell最大股东之一。谷歌每向Marvell采购5亿美元合格芯片，即可获得约24万股归属权益，双方合作预计到2033财年可为Marvell带来约1200亿美元营收。此次合作涵盖与谷歌TPU配套使用的多种技术，包括运行AI模型、管理数据存储及数据中心网络传输的处理器。消息公布后Marvell股价大涨近8%-10%，而同样为谷歌供应定制芯片的博通股价则因投资者担忧供应商格局生变而下跌超5%。

news.titleEn: Anthropic IPO Filing Will Show AI Backlash as Risk Factor, Sources Say
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic is preparing to publicly file its IPO prospectus as soon as the end of August, with the filing expected to list growing public backlash against AI as a formal risk factor for investors.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic计划最早于8月底公开提交IPO招股书，文件预计将把公众对AI的日益反弹列为正式风险因素。
news.whyEn: A public listing from Anthropic, one of the two dominant AI labs, would be among the largest tech IPOs ever and a bellwether for how public markets price AI companies' growth against real risks like regulation, safety incidents and public sentiment.
news.whyZh: 作为两大顶尖AI实验室之一，Anthropic上市将是史上最大规模科技IPO之一，也将检验公开市场如何在AI公司的增长与监管、安全及舆论等真实风险之间定价。
news.detailEn: Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft S-1 to the SEC in June and is now preparing to publicly file its prospectus by the end of August, following investor meetings led by its CFO. The company was valued at $965 billion after a $65 billion Series H round in April, and some investors are now targeting an even larger roughly $2 trillion valuation for an IPO expected around October, led by underwriters including Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan. Sources say the filing will explicitly flag AI backlash — including public concern over job displacement, safety and misuse — as a risk factor, a rare instance of an AI leader formally acknowledging reputational and regulatory risk from the technology it sells. If it proceeds as planned, the listing could rival or exceed SpaceX's $75 billion raise in June as the largest tech flotation on record.
news.detailZh: Anthropic今年6月已向美国证券交易委员会秘密提交S-1草案，目前正在CFO主导的投资者会议后筹备最早于8月底公开提交招股书。该公司在4月完成650亿美元的H轮融资后估值达9650亿美元，部分投资者预计其IPO估值最终可能高达约2万亿美元，上市时间约在10月，承销商包括摩根士丹利、高盛和摩根大通。消息人士称，招股书将明确把「AI反弹」——包括公众对失业、安全及滥用的担忧——列为风险因素，这是AI领域领军企业罕见地正式承认其技术本身带来的声誉与监管风险。若按计划推进，此次上市规模有望媲美甚至超越SpaceX今年6月750亿美元的融资，成为史上最大规模科技上市。

news.titleEn: Bitcoin Surges 22% for the Week as Investor Optimism Floods Back
news.conclusionEn: Bitcoin jumped about 18% in 48 hours to over $77,600, capping a weekly gain of more than 20%, fueled by the Treasury's bond buyback move and a White House push for crypto-friendly regulation.
news.conclusionZh: 比特币48小时内上涨约18%，突破77600美元，单周涨幅超20%，受美国财政部回购计划及白宫推动加密监管立法提振。
news.whyEn: The rally, accompanied by a record $2.7 billion in short-position liquidations, shows how closely crypto prices are now tied to US fiscal and monetary policy signals, and a favorable Clarity Act outcome could reshape how digital assets are regulated for years.
news.whyZh: 此轮上涨伴随创纪录的27亿美元空头爆仓，显示加密货币价格已与美国财政、货币政策信号高度联动，Clarity Act若顺利通过，将长期重塑数字资产监管格局。
news.detailEn: Bitcoin rose to around $77,000 on Friday, extending a rally that began after the Treasury's surprise announcement to double its long-term bond buybacks, which investors read as an early sign of looser financial conditions. The rally accelerated after President Trump pushed Congress to pass the Clarity Act, legislation that would clarify whether cryptocurrencies are regulated as securities or commodities. The move triggered a record $2.7 billion in short-position liquidations across crypto markets in a single wave, the largest since at least 2021. Despite the surge, bitcoin remains well below its 2026 high of $94,820 set in January and its all-time high of $126,198 reached last October, suggesting the rebound is a recovery from a steep summer decline rather than a fresh record run.
news.detailZh: 比特币周五上涨至约77000美元，延续了此前因财政部意外宣布加倍长期国债回购而启动的涨势，投资者将此解读为金融环境趋松的早期信号。特朗普推动国会通过Clarity法案（旨在明确加密货币应按证券还是大宗商品监管）后，涨势进一步加速。此举在加密货币市场引发单轮创纪录的27亿美元空头爆仓，为2021年以来规模最大。尽管涨势迅猛，比特币目前仍远低于今年1月创下的94820美元年内高点，以及去年10月创下的126198美元历史最高点，表明此轮反弹更多是对夏季深度下跌的修复，而非刷新纪录的新一轮上涨。

news.titleEn: Zelenskyy Says Wartime Elections Could 'Destroy' Ukraine
news.conclusionEn: President Zelenskyy firmly rejected a call from his recently dismissed former defence minister, Mykhailo Fedorov, to hold presidential elections during the war, calling the idea a "huge risk" that could split the country.
news.conclusionZh: 泽连斯基坚决拒绝前国防部长费多罗夫提出的战时大选提议，称此举风险巨大，可能分裂国家。
news.whyEn: The public rift exposes rare internal political friction inside Ukraine after four years of war, at a moment when unity is seen as critical for sustaining Western military and financial support against Russia.
news.whyZh: 这场公开分歧暴露出乌克兰四年战争后罕见的内部政治摩擦，而团结正被视为维系西方对乌军事与财政支持的关键。
news.detailEn: Mykhailo Fedorov, who was dismissed as defence minister in July after six months in the role, posted a nine-minute video arguing that Ukraine's democracy "cannot be held hostage by Russia" and warning of a "systemic crisis of governance," effectively calling for wartime elections. Zelenskyy responded forcefully, describing the proposal as a "huge risk" and a "tsunami for the country that will split Ukraine," and noted that Ukrainian law currently bans elections during martial law. Analysts told Al Jazeera that holding elections during active war would be logistically near-impossible given displaced populations, occupied territory and security risks, a view most Ukrainians reportedly share. Fedorov remains popular, and his dismissal earlier this year had already triggered public protests, making his challenge a rare and closely watched test of Zelenskyy's political standing.
news.detailZh: 今年7月被解除国防部长职务（任职仅六个月）的费多罗夫发布一段九分钟视频，称乌克兰的民主「不能被俄罗斯挟持」，并警告国家面临「系统性治理危机」，实质上呼吁进行战时大选。泽连斯基强硬回应，称该提议「风险巨大」，是「将分裂国家的海啸」，并指出乌克兰法律目前禁止在戒严状态下举行选举。有分析人士向半岛电视台表示，鉴于人口流离失所、部分领土被占领及安全风险，战时举行选举在后勤上几乎不可能实现，多数乌克兰人似乎也认同这一看法。费多罗夫在乌克兰民众中仍颇具人气，他今年早些时候被解职就曾引发抗议，这使得他此次公开挑战成为检验泽连斯基政治地位的罕见焦点事件。

news.titleEn: Netanyahu, Katz Issue Threat to Hamas Over Kites Landing in Israel
news.conclusionEn: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz threatened to intensify strikes on Gaza and evacuate launch-site areas after at least six children's kites crossed into Israeli territory over the past week.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡与防长卡茨警告，将加大对加沙的打击力度并疏散发射区域，此前一周内至少6个儿童风筝飘入以色列境内。
news.whyEn: The threat over what Israel calls acts of war shows how fragile the Gaza ceasefire remains a year after it took effect, raising the risk of renewed large-scale fighting over incidents that IDF officials themselves say posed no actual danger.
news.whyZh: 以方将风筝事件定性为战争行为并发出威胁，显示加沙停火协议生效一年后仍十分脆弱，即便以军官员自称风筝并无实际危险，仍可能触发新一轮大规模冲突。
news.detailEn: Netanyahu and Katz held an assessment meeting with IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir after the military identified at least six kites, some flown by children, that crossed from Gaza into Israeli border communities over the past week, including four over the weekend. IDF officials told Israeli media that nothing suspicious was found on the kites and that they posed no danger to the public, but Katz declared that "a balloon is treated like a kite, and a kite is treated like a drone, with or without explosives," calling every launch "an act of war." The two leaders said Israeli forces would act to increase targeted strikes against those responsible and evacuate populated areas used as launch sites. Hamas, in response, urged the US and mediating countries to press Israel over what it called the "destruction of the ceasefire framework," underscoring rising strain on the truce that has been in place since October 2025.
news.detailZh: 内塔尼亚胡与卡茨在以军总参谋长扎米尔的陪同下召开评估会议，此前军方确认过去一周内至少有6个风筝（部分由儿童放飞）从加沙飘入以色列边境社区，其中4个是在周末发现的。以军官员对以色列媒体表示，风筝上未发现可疑物品，也未对公众构成实际危险，但卡茨仍宣称「气球等同风筝，风筝等同无人机，无论是否携带爆炸物」，并将每一次放飞都定性为「战争行为」。两位领导人表示，以军将加大对责任方的定点打击，并疏散被用作发射地点的人口聚居区。哈马斯则呼吁美国及斡旋各国向以方施压，指责其「摧毁停火框架」，凸显这份自2025年10月生效的停火协议正承受越来越大的压力。

news.titleEn: Amazon's Prime Air Is Taking Off in Nearly 500 US Cities
news.conclusionEn: Amazon announced plans to expand its Prime Air drone-delivery service to nearly 500 US cities and towns by the end of 2026, a roughly sixfold increase from its current footprint.
news.conclusionZh: 亚马逊宣布计划到2026年底将Prime Air无人机配送服务扩展至近500个美国城镇，较目前规模扩大约六倍。
news.whyEn: The rapid scale-up signals Amazon is betting heavily on drone delivery as a mainstream logistics channel, intensifying a race with Walmart's Wing and Zipline partnerships and DoorDash's newly approved drone network for last-mile delivery dominance.
news.whyZh: 快速扩张显示亚马逊正押注无人机配送成为主流物流方式，这将加剧其与沃尔玛（Wing、Zipline）及刚获批的DoorDash无人机网络之间在最后一公里配送领域的竞争。
news.detailEn: Prime Air currently operates across 11 metro areas in seven states — Arizona, Florida, Kansas, Louisiana, Michigan, Nebraska and Texas — with each site covering about 175 square miles, and Amazon says it has already delivered hundreds of thousands of packages by drone this year. The company plans to soon add locations in Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta and Boise, with further expansion into Georgia, Ohio, Illinois, Idaho and New York later this year. The service covers items weighing 5 pounds or less and promises delivery in as fast as 30 minutes; Prime members get free delivery on orders over $50 (a $2.99 fee below that), while non-Prime customers pay $4.99. Amazon says the expansion relies on FAA Part 135 certification and a detect-and-avoid system, addressing safety concerns raised by earlier drone incidents, as rivals Walmart and DoorDash push their own competing drone-delivery networks.
news.detailZh: Prime Air目前在美国7个州的11个都市区运营——亚利桑那、佛罗里达、堪萨斯、路易斯安那、密歇根、内布拉斯加和德克萨斯，每个站点覆盖约175平方英里，亚马逊称今年已通过无人机完成数十万件包裹配送。公司计划近期在芝加哥、锡拉丘兹、克利夫兰、亚特兰大和博伊西新增站点，年内还将进一步扩展至佐治亚、俄亥俄、伊利诺伊、爱达荷和纽约。该服务面向5磅以下商品，承诺最快30分钟送达；Prime会员满50美元订单免运费（不足则收2.99美元），非会员需支付4.99美元运费。亚马逊表示，此次扩张依托FAA 135部认证及「探测-规避」系统，以回应此前无人机事故引发的安全担忧，同时沃尔玛与DoorDash也在推进各自的竞争性无人机配送网络。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money, or effort into a decision because of what has already been spent, rather than evaluating the choice based on future costs and benefits. Sunk costs — money already spent — are gone regardless of what you do next, so they should not factor into forward-looking decisions. Recognizing this bias helps managers and individuals cut losses on failing projects instead of escalating commitment. It is one of the most common reasons companies keep funding products or strategies long after the evidence says to stop.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误指人们因为已经投入的时间、金钱或精力，而倾向于继续投入某个决策，而不是基于未来的成本与收益重新评估。已经花掉的钱无论接下来怎么做都无法收回，因此不应影响面向未来的决策。识破这一偏见能帮助管理者和个人及时止损，而不是对失败的项目不断加码投入。这也是许多企业明明证据已表明该止步，却仍持续为某产品或战略投钱的常见原因。
businessTips.exampleEn: A startup has spent $2 million building a feature that user testing shows nobody wants. The founders keep funding it for another six months, reasoning "we've already put so much into this" — instead of redirecting the remaining budget to a feature with proven demand. The rational move is to ask only: given what we know now, is continuing the best use of the next dollar?
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家创业公司已花费200万美元开发一项功能，但用户测试显示几乎没人需要它。创始人却以「已经投入这么多」为由继续投入六个月，而不是把剩余预算转向已被验证有需求的功能。理性的做法应该只问一个问题：以现在掌握的信息来看，继续投入是不是下一分钱的最佳用途？

businessTips.explanationEn: Bootstrapping means building and growing a business using only personal savings, early revenue, and reinvested profits — without raising outside venture capital or taking on debt. It forces founders to reach profitability quickly and keep costs lean, since there is no investor cushion to fall back on. The tradeoff is slower growth compared to well-funded competitors, but founders retain full ownership and control, and the business isn't pressured to chase growth metrics that don't fit its natural pace. Many successful side hustles and small businesses stay bootstrapped permanently by choice.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自筹资金创业（Bootstrapping）指仅靠个人积蓄、早期营收和滚存利润来搭建并发展业务，而不引入风险投资或举债。由于没有投资人的资金缓冲，创始人必须尽快实现盈利并严格控制成本。代价是相较于融资充足的竞争对手，成长速度会较慢，但创始人能保留完整的股权与控制权，业务也不会被迫追逐不符合自身节奏的增长指标。许多成功的副业和小企业出于主动选择，会一直保持自筹资金的状态。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone starts a niche online course business using only a laptop and $200 in ad spend, reinvesting every dollar of profit into better content and marketing instead of seeking outside funding. Two years later it's a profitable six-figure business fully owned by the founder, having grown slower than a VC-backed rival but without ever answering to outside shareholders.
businessTips.exampleZh: 有人只用一台笔记本电脑和200美元广告预算，启动了一门小众在线课程业务，把每一分利润都重新投入到内容优化和推广中，而不是寻求外部融资。两年后，这已成长为一家由创始人完全持股、年营收达六位数的盈利企业——虽然增速不及有风投支持的竞争对手，但从未需要向外部股东负责。

businessTips.explanationEn: Compound interest is interest calculated not only on the original principal but also on the accumulated interest from previous periods, causing an investment to grow at an accelerating rate over time. The longer money stays invested, the more dramatic the effect, which is why starting early matters more than the size of individual contributions in many cases. This principle underlies retirement savings, index fund investing, and even debt — credit card balances compound against the borrower the same way. Understanding compounding helps explain why small, consistent investments made early can outgrow larger investments made later.
businessTips.explanationZh: 复利是指利息不仅按最初本金计算，还会计入之前各期累积的利息，从而使投资随时间加速增长。资金投资时间越长，这种效应就越显著，这也是为什么在许多情况下，「尽早开始」比「单次投入金额大小」更重要。这一原理是退休储蓄、指数基金投资乃至债务（信用卡欠款对借款人同样以复利方式增长）背后的核心逻辑。理解复利有助于说明为什么较早开始的小额持续投资，长期来看可能超过较晚开始的大额投资。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone who invests $200 a month starting at age 25 with a 7% average annual return will have significantly more at retirement than someone who invests $400 a month starting at age 35, purely because the first investor's money compounds for an extra decade. The lesson: time in the market often matters more than the amount invested at any single point.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个人从25岁起每月投资200美元，按年化7%的平均回报率计算，到退休时的资产会明显多于从35岁起每月投资400美元的人——原因仅仅是前者的资金多复利增长了整整十年。这说明：在市场中持续投资的时间长度，往往比某一时刻投入的金额大小更重要。
